A new **Fighter** starts with: **Longsword**, **Shield**, **Potion of Healing**, and **Torches** (item IDs 2, 15, 17, 23 — though code comments mislabel #23 as "Rations", a known bug B-09).

Defined in `worker/src/services/character.ts` in the `CLASS_STARTING_ITEMS` map (around lines 59/65), with item names/IDs seeded by `worker/src/db/seed.sql` (insert order defines IDs 1–28). Documented in `docs/flows/character-creation.md` (Class/race table) and `worker/src/db/seed.md`.
